about: Answer key for Mini practice 3 (instructor use). Synthetic teaching data: one person, one 120-kb locus, six libraries. Read models approximate public platform specifications but are not calibrated to any real run.
ALTX_mixed_chains: E2a+E4b and E2b+E4a do not exist (0%)

SNV1.name: SNV1
SNV1.note: exon 3 of ASE1; heterozygous, on hap1

SNV2.name: SNV2
SNV2.note: intron 2 of ASE1; heterozygous, on hap2

variants.phase: trans: SNV1 alt on hap1, SNV2 alt on hap2 (3,000 bp apart)

duplication.illumina_rule: a read inside one copy that avoids the 3 differing bases gets MAPQ 0 and is placed in either copy at random

DNA-ILMN.error: substitutions only; 0.03% at base 1 rising to 0.25% at base 150, p(x) = 0.0003 + 0.0006 x + 0.0016 x^12, x = cycle / (read length - 1); mean 0.073% (99.93% correct), ~87% of bases >= Q30
DNA-ILMN.qual: per cycle, Phred of the error model (Q26-Q35)

DNA-HIFI.length: N(16 kb, 3 kb) truncated to 8-30 kb
DNA-HIFI.error: per-read rate log-normal around 5e-4 (Q33); 20% substitutions, 40% insertions, 40% deletions; extra homopolymer length errors
DNA-HIFI.qual: one value per read (Phred of its error rate)

DNA-ONT.length: log-normal, sigma 0.9, N50 about 22 kb, 1-100 kb
DNA-ONT.error: per-read rate log-normal around 1% (Q20), 0.3-3%; 35% substitutions, 20% insertions, 45% deletions; homopolymer length errors (runs >= 5)
DNA-ONT.qual: one value per read (Phred of its error rate)

RNA-ILMN.error: as DNA-ILMN, the same curve over 100 cycles (0.03% rising to 0.25%)

RNA-ONT.error: per-read rate log-normal around 3% (Q15), 1.5-6%; 30% substitutions, 20% insertions, 50% deletions; homopolymer length errors

sampling: Long DNA reads start on a jittered grid and alternate between haplotypes, so that ~20x over one locus is not dominated by sampling noise. Real runs scatter reads at random.
simplifications: Alignments are projections of the simulated haplotypes, not the output of an aligner.
Illumina reads carry substitutions only; real Illumina data have rare indels.
Long-read QUAL holds one value per read; real HiFi and nanopore files vary base by base.
Methylation tables are per-CpG summaries computed from simulated per-molecule calls.
All four genes are on the + strand; there is no antisense transcription.

teaching_facts_checked_by_build.fact: F01 short reads have fixed lengths (150 / 100 bp)
F01 long DNA reads: N50 14-30 kb; ONT N50 well above its median
F01 long RNA reads are no longer than the transcripts (N50 <= 2,250 nt)
F02 Illumina and HiFi both >= 99.85% accurate; ONT DNA 98.5-99.5%; ONT RNA least accurate
F02 ONT errors are mostly deletions; Illumina makes no indels
F02 at HP1, ONT reads 9 or 11 A far more often than HiFi or Illumina
F03 OFF1 has normal DNA depth and zero RNA depth; RNA bases sit in exons
F04 SNV1: every DNA interval contains 0.5; every RNA interval excludes 0.5 and contains 0.85
F05 junctions ~60/40 at both alternative exons; no complete chain in short reads; no mixed chain
F06 direct RNA is 3'-biased (ratio >= 2, 20-40% reach the 5' end); Kinnex and Illumina near flat
F07 HiFi and ONT size both alleles (25 and ~180 units), ONT wider; Illumina sees only 25 plus all-CAG reads
F08 at MAPQ >= 20 Illumina loses DUP_A (ratio < 0.3); long reads keep it (>= 0.8)
F09 no Illumina read covers both SNVs; long reads show only alt-ref and ref-alt (trans)
F10 Illumina loses depth in GC >= 60% windows (ratio < 0.8, drop > 3 x scatter); long reads within 0.85-1.15
F11 ALTX promoter low (< 0.15) and OFF1 promoter high (> 0.75) in both long-read tables
F12 all RNA datasets rank ASE1 > ALTX > LOW1 > OFF1 = 0, shares within 0.05 of 10:4:1
